feature_source: Qlib Alpha158DL.get_feature_config, 158 expressions, same as alpha158-lightgbm-2023-diagnostic

features.preprocessing: No fitted transforms; replace feature NaN and infinity with zero before the fixed MLP.

label.target: pandas average rank(pct=True) - 0.5 within eligible signal-day members
label.missing_endpoint: exclude the label, never replace with zero

portfolio.rank_order: descending predicted score, then ascending symbol for ties
portfolio.candidate_filter: signal-day conditional member with finite prediction and finite close
portfolio.execution: freeze units at signal close, execute next session open
portfolio.quarter_boundary: continue holdings; next scheduled rebalance uses the new model
portfolio.control: all conditional members, same dates, initial cash and costs

primary_comparison: base-cost MLP top30 versus matched equal weight, 2023-07-03 through 2023-12-29
interpretation: This is a fixed architecture baseline, not a tuned neural-network result.
The 2023 interval is a development diagnostic and is not a blind final test.
The same candidate, adjusted-unit execution, costs, windows and top30 selection as the LightGBM comparison apply.
A positive relative result or IC would not establish a profitable executable strategy; preserve a negative result.
Source-native prices and volumes remain uncertified candidates; formal PIT, company-action and tradeability gaps remain.
